response.sql: WITH rental_payments AS (SELECT r.rental_id, i.store_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount, COUNT(*) AS payment_count FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id WHERE p.amount >= 4.99 GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id) SELECT store_id, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_rental_total, AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payments_per_rental FROM rental_payments GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
